NZ Minister Alleges Covert Immigration Changes in India FTA

New Zealand's Foreign Minister Winston Peters has accused India of covertly altering immigration rules under their Free Trade Agreement. Peters claims these changes, including stricter visa and residency requirements, were deliberately implemented to target Indian citizens and restrict their entry. The allegations suggest a potential strain on the bilateral trade relationship.
